data.title: Quality Improvement - Refactoring

data.author: plan
data.comment:
Auto-plan completed with review: effort and risk below threshold. Review summary:
- Stage 1 (Requirements & AC alignment): Added Acceptance Criteria to both children (remove unused var, ruff passes, no behavioral changes).
- Stage 2 (Completeness): Both children now have required AC sections. No Key Files needed for trivial lint fixes.
- Stage 3 (Sequencing & dependencies): Independent fixes, no dependencies. Correct ordering.
- Stage 4 (Scope sizing): Both Extra Small, appropriate for single-line ruff F841 fixes.
- Stage 5 (Acceptance & testability): ACs are pass/fail, testable via `ruff check`.
- Stage 6 (Polish & handoff): Descriptions clear and actionable.
AC coverage: 100%, recommendation: proceed.
